attack_surface.boundary: verify-then-accept: what runs before a ref, baseline, index, policy or file is accepted from the host, and the paths a key or server address takes through the CLI

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: features and min_client follow the server's copy on merge, so a host replaying an older index can drop them (TM-R29); a fresh clone takes whatever the host serves
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: a clone never lowers the format number it has seen

secrets_exposure.note: see the dossier for the exact functions; TM-R14/TM-R15 cover keys on argv, stdout and disk

proposed.fix: min_client never goes down without --force, mirroring the format rule

risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: vault format: min_client can go down (format never does); a write-key holder or a replayed index lowers the floor that keeps old clients out of writes

risk_decision.rationale: KNOWN (TM-R14), with two items the register does not name: the write key on stdout (derive-keys) and the read key after every clone

vulnerabilities.title: cmd_info prints the passphrase, the full vault key, the read key and a web URL carrying the bare vault key in its fragment; cmd_derive_keys prints the write key in bare hex; cmd_clone prints the read key after every full clone

proposed.fix: health-check without the token (the API's health endpoint needs none), or confirm the host before sending it

risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: remote add / set-url / the remote setup prompt send the stored token to a user-typed URL for a health check before that URL is recorded

risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: vault ignore --apply writes its removal commit unsigned, silently, when the clone's .pem is missing; commit warns in the same case

risk_decision.proposed: One rule for legacy backup names: glob only what _LEGACY_BACKUP_ZIP matches, or protect *__uninit.zip in is_protected. Parametrised negative test on both sides.
risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: init --restore globs *__uninit.zip but the path guard protects only the exact 0.20.0 spelling (_LEGACY_BACKUP_ZIP)
